profile.headline: Software Engineer - Adventure Enthusiast - Lego Artist
profile.summary:
How I got here: A decade of uninspiring jobs and walking traditional paths made me realize that to truly feel happy and relevant, I had to reach higher. For me, reaching higher meant quitting a stable job and going all-in on becoming a software engineer. It was a high-risk gamble that resulted in a software engineering role, responsible for a web application. Reflecting on this role, I’ve realized my passion for programming comes from the thrill of a challenge, constant growth, and the ability to use my creativity in ways that can benefit the world.

Hobbies: Equestrian trick riding, puzzling, building Lego kits (R2D2 most recent), and creating 'Lego Art.'

2024 Goals: Building a real-life R2D2, building a real estate investment application in Python, being happy.

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Git · Anthropic Claude · MongoDB

positions.title: Salesforce & Recruitment Specialist
positions.description:
- Audit and optimization; automated recruitment case and lead collection using Salesforce, resulting in increased efficiency
- Database management; implemented validation rules to increase data integrity
- Customization and feature development; created Salesforce dashboards tailored to the needs of the end users
- Debugging; diagnose and fix issues within Salesforce, including configuration settings, faulty defaults and system updates

positions.title: Associate Engineer
positions.description:
I maintained an internal web application; debugging, updating service versions, new feature development, application testing, and database maintenance
Achievements:
- Increased business efficiency by developing a wizard that combines seven business workflows into one
- Automated updating of business records by writing a script that makes an API call on a schedule
- Contributed to creating a UI that finds and alerts the user of required business asset maintenance dependent on user credentials
positions.insights: Skills: GitHub · Bootstrap · Git · jQuery · Ruby · Docker · Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Expert Personal Trainer
positions.description: I’m a contracted expert personal trainer for Zen Fitness. It’s my responsible to generating leads for potential training clients, but I also accept clients from Zen Fitness staff.

positions.title: Staff Assistant
positions.description: I manage a team of four within a fast-paced, detail-oriented orthopedic surgeon’s clinic. Daily activities include scheduling surgeries and appointments, corresponding with home health care agencies, other clinics, and the hospital. I encounter patient’s daily, in person and on the phone. It’s critical that I juggle multiple tasks and maintain attention to detail. Normal administrative duties are an everyday chore, but they also include hiring of staff and attending monthly meetings to discuss benchmarks and how the company can do better on patient care and meeting financial goals.

positions.title: Medical Technician/Receptionist
positions.description: I make sure my clinic runs efficiently, assist the doctor with patient interactions and receptionist duties.

positions.title: Senior Education Consultant
positions.description:
I helped to lead a small team of about 5-9 people towards daily sales goals. My main responsibility was to educate our employee's on new and current products and how to apply them. 
Skills: Money handling, high-level customer service, high knowledge of products and their ingredients, fast-paced environment, multi-tasking.

positions.title: Operations Manager
positions.description:
Responsibilities include maintaining visual elements of the store and controlling inventory. There's also a minor leadership role involved, but the focus of my role was on creating an appealing merchandise set with the goal to sell the product. 
Skills: High-level of customer service, sales, leadership, money-handling, inventory control, watching out for shrinkage

positions.title: Design Intern
positions.description: I work on design projects handed to me from my design leaders.

positions.title: Customer Service Associate
positions.description:
I handled money, customer service and did visual merchandising work.
Skills: Customer service, money handling, inventory, and merchandise sets.

positions.title: Reporting Intern
positions.description: I reported on community events around Gainesville, FL and published in the Local & State section of The Gainesville Sun. See my website for articles.

positions.title: Web Editor
positions.description: I updated the publication website, designed layouts for online content, created graphics for the website, and updated the publication's social media. I also wrote reviews on events, books, and local restaurants.

certifications.title: Certificate of Completion: Al Fluency Framework & Foundations

volunteerExperiences.description: I helped coordinate a road clean up with the Santa Fe Police Department and The IT Club. The road is a part of the Keep Alachua County Beautiful effort and was adopted by the SFPD.
